decision: strict frozen protocol for every gate, decided with the user; a labelled happy-path-only diagnostic is run separately and never merged
reason: SUITE_SHAPE_REFUSED: at the product commit both GreenMail suites (home-email-gm-w1, home-email-gm-fault) generate two cases, happy_path and missing_precondition 'service names a record that does not exist'. The frozen re-run protocol (rerun.sh suite-shape check, reproduced in run-frozen-58.sh setup) refuses to score a suite that is not the single demonstrated case, because the agent would act a second time before the oracle reads the mailbox.
cause: N-1 identity change: the GreenMail inbox read (Record1) was keyed by its changing message count at AFTER-2 and is keyed by the stable service field now; send_email's service parameter therefore references an existing record, and the generator's invalidate_identifier mutation (packages/generator/src/mutations.ts) emits a missing_precondition case.
